job.title: Software Engineer, Wallets, Liquidity and Bridging Team
job.pay_full: $152,405 – $179,300 a year base salary (excluding equity and bonus); total compensation may also include equity, bonus eligibility and benefits

details.about: Coinbase's Wallets team lets users around the world interact with more than 50 blockchains, and its backend has already powered billions of crypto addresses and requests. The team owns the services behind every send and receive in Coinbase's custodial products: distributed systems that construct, sign, broadcast and ingest onchain transactions. Coinbase is remote-first but not remote-only, with quarterly in-person working sessions.
duties: Design, develop and maintain Coinbase's wallet systems
Work with teams across the company on integrations with the team's services
Take part in code reviews and give constructive feedback
needs: Experience designing, building, scaling and maintaining production services, and composing a service-oriented architecture
Excellent communication and collaboration skills and strong attention to detail
Ownership of well-scoped problems from investigation through implementation, rollout and production support
details.benefits: Annual base salary $152,405 – $179,300 (excluding equity and bonus); base salary varies by location. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).
notes: Remote-first, with quarterly in-person working sessions called "surges"
Candidates may submit at most 3 applications within a 6-month period
